framework.formula: Available clinker / clinker factor -> theoretical cement potential; subtract runtime, rate, feed, additive, power, silo, packing, dispatch and planning losses -> actual cement.

loss_tree.recommended_action: Restore mill availability; confirm whether stop is mechanical, electrical, planned, or interlock-related.
Escalate truck, weighbridge, loading schedule, and customer pickup constraints.
Optimize mill rate by checking separator, ventilation, grinding media/liners, feed size, and clinker grindability.

root_causes: Plan not aligned with additive/dispatch readiness
loss_tree.recommended_action: Realign product sequence, silo allocation, sales demand, additives, and dispatch plan.

root_causes: Wrong cement type additive not ready
loss_tree.recommended_action: Secure required additive stock and confirm feeder readiness for the active cement type.
Recover packing/loading capacity by checking packers, bags, loaders, spouts, and bay congestion.
Coordinate power/load priority and agree whether mill load should be reduced or production rescheduled.
Restore stable clinker feed by checking bin level, belts, elevators, feeders, and chute blockages.
Open evacuation path through silo selection, extraction, packing, dispatch, or product changeover.

recommendations: Restore cement mill availability first; this is lost production time, not lost clinker.
High free lime forecast: stabilize burning intensity and review feed loading before the next lab result arrives.
Low liter weight risk: check nodulization, cooler bed condition, and burning stability.
Raw meal LSF is pushing the burnability limit; confirm corrective mix control.
Burning zone is below target; check flame shape, fuel feed, and draft stability.
Secondary air heat recovery is weak; inspect cooler grate speed, bed depth, and fan balance.
Fuel moisture is elevated; expect slower thermal response and verify mill drying.

framework.formula: Available clinker / clinker factor -> theoretical cement potential; subtract runtime, rate, feed, additive, power, silo, packing, dispatch and planning losses -> actual cement.

loss_tree.recommended_action: Restore mill availability; confirm whether stop is mechanical, electrical, planned, or interlock-related.
Escalate truck, weighbridge, loading schedule, and customer pickup constraints.

root_causes: Wrong cement type additive not ready
loss_tree.recommended_action: Secure required additive stock and confirm feeder readiness for the active cement type.

root_causes: Plan not aligned with additive/dispatch readiness
loss_tree.recommended_action: Realign product sequence, silo allocation, sales demand, additives, and dispatch plan.
Recover packing/loading capacity by checking packers, bags, loaders, spouts, and bay congestion.
Optimize mill rate by checking separator, ventilation, grinding media/liners, feed size, and clinker grindability.
Coordinate power/load priority and agree whether mill load should be reduced or production rescheduled.
Restore stable clinker feed by checking bin level, belts, elevators, feeders, and chute blockages.
Open evacuation path through silo selection, extraction, packing, dispatch, or product changeover.

losses.name: Planning mismatch
losses.cause: Product mix or sequence not aligned with demand/storage

losses.name: Packing bottleneck
losses.cause: Packing/loading cannot evacuate cement fast enough

losses.name: Dispatch/truck constraint
losses.cause: Truck or dispatch readiness limits evacuation

losses.name: No clinker feed
losses.cause: Mill starved by clinker transport/feed constraint

loss_tree.recommended_action: Restore mill availability; confirm whether stop is mechanical, electrical, planned, or interlock-related.
Optimize mill rate by checking separator, ventilation, grinding media/liners, feed size, and clinker grindability.

root_causes: Plan not aligned with additive/dispatch readiness
loss_tree.recommended_action: Realign product sequence, silo allocation, sales demand, additives, and dispatch plan.
Recover packing/loading capacity by checking packers, bags, loaders, spouts, and bay congestion.
Escalate truck, weighbridge, loading schedule, and customer pickup constraints.

root_causes: Wrong cement type additive not ready
loss_tree.recommended_action: Secure required additive stock and confirm feeder readiness for the active cement type.
Coordinate power/load priority and agree whether mill load should be reduced or production rescheduled.
Restore stable clinker feed by checking bin level, belts, elevators, feeders, and chute blockages.
Open evacuation path through silo selection, extraction, packing, dispatch, or product changeover.

top_losses.cause: Truck or dispatch readiness limits evacuation

daily_review.meeting_prompt: Review the top three losses, confirm evidence, assign owner, agree action and due time before next shift review.

action_plan.action: Escalate truck availability, weighbridge, loading, and dispatch planning constraints.

recommendations: Escalate truck availability, weighbridge, loading, and dispatch planning constraints.
No immediate intervention. Continue monitoring chemistry, thermal stability, and cooler recovery.

framework.formula: Available clinker / clinker factor -> theoretical cement potential; subtract runtime, rate, feed, additive, power, silo, packing, dispatch and planning losses -> actual cement.

top_loss.name: Dispatch/truck constraint
top_loss.cause: Truck or dispatch readiness limits evacuation

losses.name: Dispatch/truck constraint
losses.cause: Truck or dispatch readiness limits evacuation

losses.name: Planning mismatch
losses.cause: Product mix or sequence not aligned with demand/storage

losses.name: Packing bottleneck
losses.cause: Packing/loading cannot evacuate cement fast enough

losses.name: No clinker feed
losses.cause: Mill starved by clinker transport/feed constraint

loss_tree.recommended_action: Escalate truck, weighbridge, loading schedule, and customer pickup constraints.
Restore mill availability; confirm whether stop is mechanical, electrical, planned, or interlock-related.

root_causes: Wrong cement type additive not ready
loss_tree.recommended_action: Secure required additive stock and confirm feeder readiness for the active cement type.

root_causes: Plan not aligned with additive/dispatch readiness
loss_tree.recommended_action: Realign product sequence, silo allocation, sales demand, additives, and dispatch plan.
Recover packing/loading capacity by checking packers, bags, loaders, spouts, and bay congestion.
Optimize mill rate by checking separator, ventilation, grinding media/liners, feed size, and clinker grindability.
Coordinate power/load priority and agree whether mill load should be reduced or production rescheduled.
Restore stable clinker feed by checking bin level, belts, elevators, feeders, and chute blockages.
Open evacuation path through silo selection, extraction, packing, dispatch, or product changeover.

Fuel moisture is elevated; expect slower thermal response and verify mill drying.

losses.name: Packing bottleneck

loss_tree.recommended_action: Restore mill availability; confirm whether stop is mechanical, electrical, planned, or interlock-related.

loss_tree.recommended_action: Realign product sequence, silo allocation, sales demand, additives, and dispatch plan.
Recover packing/loading capacity by checking packers, bags, loaders, spouts, and bay congestion.

root_causes: Wrong cement type additive not ready
loss_tree.recommended_action: Secure required additive stock and confirm feeder readiness for the active cement type.
Coordinate power/load priority and agree whether mill load should be reduced or production rescheduled.
Open evacuation path through silo selection, extraction, packing, dispatch, or product changeover.

losses.name: Dispatch/truck constraint
losses.cause: Truck or dispatch readiness limits evacuation

losses.name: Planning mismatch
losses.cause: Product mix or sequence not aligned with demand/storage

losses.name: No clinker feed
losses.cause: Mill starved by clinker transport/feed constraint

loss_tree.recommended_action: Coordinate power/load priority and agree whether mill load should be reduced or production rescheduled.
Restore mill availability; confirm whether stop is mechanical, electrical, planned, or interlock-related.
Optimize mill rate by checking separator, ventilation, grinding media/liners, feed size, and clinker grindability.
Recover packing/loading capacity by checking packers, bags, loaders, spouts, and bay congestion.
Escalate truck, weighbridge, loading schedule, and customer pickup constraints.

root_causes: Plan not aligned with additive/dispatch readiness
loss_tree.recommended_action: Realign product sequence, silo allocation, sales demand, additives, and dispatch plan.

root_causes: Wrong cement type additive not ready
loss_tree.recommended_action: Secure required additive stock and confirm feeder readiness for the active cement type.
Restore stable clinker feed by checking bin level, belts, elevators, feeders, and chute blockages.
Open evacuation path through silo selection, extraction, packing, dispatch, or product changeover.

top_losses.cause: Product mix or sequence not aligned with demand/storage

daily_review.meeting_prompt: Review the top three losses, confirm evidence, assign owner, agree action and due time before next shift review.

action_plan.action: Restore cement mill availability first; this is lost production time, not lost clinker.

recommendations: Restore cement mill availability first; this is lost production time, not lost clinker.
No immediate intervention. Continue monitoring chemistry, thermal stability, and cooler recovery.

framework.formula: Available clinker / clinker factor -> theoretical cement potential; subtract runtime, rate, feed, additive, power, silo, packing, dispatch and planning losses -> actual cement.

losses.name: Planning mismatch
losses.cause: Product mix or sequence not aligned with demand/storage

losses.name: Dispatch/truck constraint
losses.cause: Truck or dispatch readiness limits evacuation

losses.name: Packing bottleneck
losses.cause: Packing/loading cannot evacuate cement fast enough

losses.name: No clinker feed
losses.cause: Mill starved by clinker transport/feed constraint

loss_tree.recommended_action: Restore mill availability; confirm whether stop is mechanical, electrical, planned, or interlock-related.

root_causes: Plan not aligned with additive/dispatch readiness
loss_tree.recommended_action: Realign product sequence, silo allocation, sales demand, additives, and dispatch plan.
Optimize mill rate by checking separator, ventilation, grinding media/liners, feed size, and clinker grindability.
Escalate truck, weighbridge, loading schedule, and customer pickup constraints.
Recover packing/loading capacity by checking packers, bags, loaders, spouts, and bay congestion.

root_causes: Wrong cement type additive not ready
loss_tree.recommended_action: Secure required additive stock and confirm feeder readiness for the active cement type.
Coordinate power/load priority and agree whether mill load should be reduced or production rescheduled.
Restore stable clinker feed by checking bin level, belts, elevators, feeders, and chute blockages.
Open evacuation path through silo selection, extraction, packing, dispatch, or product changeover.

top_losses.cause: Truck or dispatch readiness limits evacuation

daily_review.meeting_prompt: Review the top three losses, confirm evidence, assign owner, agree action and due time before next shift review.

action_plan.action: Restore cement mill availability first; this is lost production time, not lost clinker.

recommendations: Restore cement mill availability first; this is lost production time, not lost clinker.
No immediate intervention. Continue monitoring chemistry, thermal stability, and cooler recovery.

framework.formula: Available clinker / clinker factor -> theoretical cement potential; subtract runtime, rate, feed, additive, power, silo, packing, dispatch and planning losses -> actual cement.

losses.name: Dispatch/truck constraint
losses.cause: Truck or dispatch readiness limits evacuation

losses.name: Planning mismatch
losses.cause: Product mix or sequence not aligned with demand/storage

losses.name: Packing bottleneck
losses.cause: Packing/loading cannot evacuate cement fast enough

losses.name: No clinker feed
losses.cause: Mill starved by clinker transport/feed constraint

loss_tree.recommended_action: Restore mill availability; confirm whether stop is mechanical, electrical, planned, or interlock-related.
Optimize mill rate by checking separator, ventilation, grinding media/liners, feed size, and clinker grindability.
Escalate truck, weighbridge, loading schedule, and customer pickup constraints.

root_causes: Plan not aligned with additive/dispatch readiness
loss_tree.recommended_action: Realign product sequence, silo allocation, sales demand, additives, and dispatch plan.
Recover packing/loading capacity by checking packers, bags, loaders, spouts, and bay congestion.

root_causes: Wrong cement type additive not ready
loss_tree.recommended_action: Secure required additive stock and confirm feeder readiness for the active cement type.
Coordinate power/load priority and agree whether mill load should be reduced or production rescheduled.
Restore stable clinker feed by checking bin level, belts, elevators, feeders, and chute blockages.
Open evacuation path through silo selection, extraction, packing, dispatch, or product changeover.

top_losses.cause: Product mix or sequence not aligned with demand/storage

daily_review.meeting_prompt: Review the top three losses, confirm evidence, assign owner, agree action and due time before next shift review.

action_plan.action: Coordinate power availability and load priorities before blaming kiln or mill performance.

recommendations: Coordinate power availability and load priorities before blaming kiln or mill performance.
No immediate intervention. Continue monitoring chemistry, thermal stability, and cooler recovery.

framework.formula: Available clinker / clinker factor -> theoretical cement potential; subtract runtime, rate, feed, additive, power, silo, packing, dispatch and planning losses -> actual cement.

losses.name: Planning mismatch
losses.cause: Product mix or sequence not aligned with demand/storage

losses.name: Dispatch/truck constraint
losses.cause: Truck or dispatch readiness limits evacuation

losses.name: Packing bottleneck
losses.cause: Packing/loading cannot evacuate cement fast enough

losses.name: No clinker feed
losses.cause: Mill starved by clinker transport/feed constraint

loss_tree.recommended_action: Coordinate power/load priority and agree whether mill load should be reduced or production rescheduled.
Restore mill availability; confirm whether stop is mechanical, electrical, planned, or interlock-related.

root_causes: Plan not aligned with additive/dispatch readiness
loss_tree.recommended_action: Realign product sequence, silo allocation, sales demand, additives, and dispatch plan.
Escalate truck, weighbridge, loading schedule, and customer pickup constraints.
Recover packing/loading capacity by checking packers, bags, loaders, spouts, and bay congestion.

root_causes: Wrong cement type additive not ready
loss_tree.recommended_action: Secure required additive stock and confirm feeder readiness for the active cement type.
Optimize mill rate by checking separator, ventilation, grinding media/liners, feed size, and clinker grindability.
Restore stable clinker feed by checking bin level, belts, elevators, feeders, and chute blockages.
Open evacuation path through silo selection, extraction, packing, dispatch, or product changeover.
